changelog.title: Features
items: Split, Macro and Burst buttons with adjustable speed, counts and Macro on Feed.
Move Controls: drag and resize the Split, Macro, Game Split, Game Feed, Settings, Zoom + and Zoom - buttons.
Custom icons for the Split and Macro buttons, plus Hide and Reset options.
Game Speed control.
Dynamic Zoom, static zoom levels, Zoom UI buttons and Zoom Label.
Party Mode: Copy Code, Friends Counter and Friend Tracker.
Player Labels: Levels, Mass, Nicknames, Skins, Enemy Score and Can Split.
Counters: Dynamic Score, Merge Timer, Ping, FPS and Token Counter.
Arena options: Grid, Start Big, Arrow and Dark Background.
Skins: Custom Skins, Mystery Skins, Skin Editor, Pellets and Fastest Scroll.
Unlock Account and Coin Skins (fake, client side only).
Emoji Toggle, Close After Use and Get Emojis.
Joystick options: Stop On Release and Direction On Touch.
Notifications, Dropdown Messages and Player Joined Party controls.
Popup control: General Popups, Continue Playing, Prevent Reset and VIP popups.
Show options: Mystic Treasure, Offline Event, Quests and Online Status.
Menu Sounds and Game Sounds toggles.
Virus Color, custom Game Background and custom Lobby Background.
120 FPS, Force Animations and Deals toggles.
Backup: Import, Export and Reset of all settings.
Check For Updates and an in-app Changelog.
Crash reports you can share to get bugs fixed.
